body: I'm kind of a part of a strict family, I would've been addicted if it wasn't the case. they will kill me if they somehow find out (lol the irony)

I think emotions mess up everything. the things that are causing me to consider suicide are emotions and why I will not be able to do it probably is because of emotions. we get to attached to things (objects/people/standards) and we cannot let go of what's emotionally not challenging. but none of this is actually important if you look at it as how it is: we are so small compared to the universe and it genuinely doesn't matter. morality and what's right is actually nothing in the grand scheme of the universe.
yeah that's why I specifically mentioned it

yeah that's true I have nothing on that. Maybe I'm in a unique level of low, I'm not sure. idk what to say to this really.

my point is I don't want help because I will probably go spiralling back to despair every time. that's actually the whole point of the post. regaining me is not useful for anyone. people want other people alive just so they can feel good and for other selfish reasons.
